title: Dotson Interview task 1

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Hello my good friend. It has been too long. I assume you are here for your first test.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello my good friend. It has been too long. I assume you are here for your first test.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: We will evaluate your deductive reasoning, your instincts, your perception and your logical problem-solving skills.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We will evaluate your deductive reasoning, your instincts, your perception and your logical problem-solving skills.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Excellent. In our last meeting, I asked you a question and asked you to prepare an answer. Do you recall the question?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excellent. In our last meeting, I asked you a question and asked you to prepare an answer. Do you recall the question?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: No. That is... were you not listening? At all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. That is... were you not listening? At all?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: And your answer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And your answer?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: "What separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "What separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?"

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Pragmatic. But not wrong. Very good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pragmatic. But not wrong. Very good.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Those are very nice words individually, but in that order they really make very little sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those are very nice words individually, but in that order they really make very little sense.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: There is a nugget of wisdom here, but I wonder if we both see it. For now, I will assume we do. Very good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is a nugget of wisdom here, but I wonder if we both see it. For now, I will assume we do. Very good.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Attend closely. I shall outline your challenge, then accept no further queries or comments until it is complete. Are you ready?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Attend closely. I shall outline your challenge, then accept no further queries or comments until it is complete. Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: This task is simple enough. The first part of your entrance exam is this: "Find out who stole Danny Dannetti's new donut recipe." That is the length and breadth of your task.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This task is simple enough. The first part of your entrance exam is this: "Find out who stole Danny Dannetti's new donut recipe." That is the length and breadth of your task.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: A sense of righteous triumph?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A sense of righteous triumph?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Do you take me for an amateur snoop? A lowly gumshoe? A paid peeper?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you take me for an amateur snoop? A lowly gumshoe? A paid peeper?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: To detect is my calling. I cannot offer financial remuneration at this early stage of your detecting career. Only a badge of honor. An I.M.P.U.N.E.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To detect is my calling. I cannot offer financial remuneration at this early stage of your detecting career. Only a badge of honor. An I.M.P.U.N.E.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: An Investigation Mandate for Private Unlimited and Neutral Examination.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An Investigation Mandate for Private Unlimited and Neutral Examination.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I have a list of suspects. People who could stand to profit from such a desperate act. Would you like to hear why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a list of suspects. People who could stand to profit from such a desperate act. Would you like to hear why?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Then it is up to Dotson to clean up the streets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then it is up to Dotson to clean up the streets.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Suspect one: Ma Gomba. The Fungal Femme Fatale. She and Danny were seen conspiring after hours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Suspect one: Ma Gomba. The Fungal Femme Fatale. She and Danny were seen conspiring after hours.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Suspect two: Calhoun the Loanshark. Word on the street is that Danny Danetti should be called Danny DEBTnetti.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Suspect two: Calhoun the Loanshark. Word on the street is that Danny Danetti should be called Danny DEBTnetti.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Suspect three: Razlo. Do not be fooled by his adorable curls. I detect a malice in the young man to rival any CEO.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Suspect three: Razlo. Do not be fooled by his adorable curls. I detect a malice in the young man to rival any CEO.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Go forth and sniff out the stench of deception!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go forth and sniff out the stench of deception!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: This will be the beginning of your entrance exam. Prepare yourself!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This will be the beginning of your entrance exam. Prepare yourself!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: It allows you to walk the mean streets after dark without being bothered by CorpSec snitchbots. Well, in a limited area, at least.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It allows you to walk the mean streets after dark without being bothered by CorpSec snitchbots. Well, in a limited area, at least.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What test?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What test?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "What separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "What separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?"
pronounText.TextSheVersion: "What separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?"
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: "What separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "What does a detective in Nivalis need to always remember?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "What does a detective in Nivalis need to always remember?"
pronounText.TextSheVersion: "What does a detective in Nivalis need to always remember?"
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: "What does a detective in Nivalis need to always remember?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "What is... a good name for a detective?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "What is... a good name for a detective?"
pronounText.TextSheVersion: "What is... a good name for a detective?"
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: "What is... a good name for a detective?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just get on with it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just get on with it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: An amateur considers all suspects equally, a master detective knows it was probably the husband.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An amateur considers all suspects equally, a master detective knows it was probably the husband.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: An amateur considers all suspects equally, a master detective knows it was probably the husband.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: An amateur considers all suspects equally, a master detective knows it was probably the husband.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: An amateur tries to tell a story that explains the crime, a master detective knows reality does not have a plotline.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An amateur tries to tell a story that explains the crime, a master detective knows reality does not have a plotline.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: An amateur tries to tell a story that explains the crime, a master detective knows reality does not have a plotline.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: An amateur tries to tell a story that explains the crime, a master detective knows reality does not have a plotline.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: An amateur tries to solve a crime, a master detective seeks only truth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An amateur tries to solve a crime, a master detective seeks only truth.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: An amateur tries to solve a crime, a master detective seeks only truth.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: An amateur tries to solve a crime, a master detective seeks only truth.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Should I write this down?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Should I write this down?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's in it for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The game is afoot!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The game is afoot!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No dice. Let's talk Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No dice. Let's talk Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That'll work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That'll work.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't this your job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't this your job?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not interested.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fair deal, leave it to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair deal, leave it to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fair deal, leave it to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fair deal, leave it to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll figure it out myself, thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll figure it out myself, thanks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll figure it out myself, thanks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll figure it out myself, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Shoot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shoot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Noted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Noted.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Damn. Who else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn. Who else?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Got it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Very suspicious!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very suspicious!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nice wordplay. Respect.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice wordplay. Respect.
